newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers mixed in thin trade.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed in thin trade on Tuesday after bouncing off the bottom early last week, traders said.
"It's very quiet today," said one West Coast player. "There is not much news."
Meanwhile, the American Petroleum Institute said it would delay until Wednesday its weekly inventory report on No. 2 oil, which often gives U.S. bunkers market direction.
In New York Harbor, spot 380 CST was about steady at between $95 and $97 a tonne. Spot 180 CST also held even at $102/103, players said.
